repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate fires at 29 seconds (29 ticks * 1000ms) instead of 30 seconds. Top-level duration waits require a 100ms wrapper period to measure duration accurately against the input grid. With period 100ms, the threshold must be 301 (300 ticks + 1) to ensure the condition holds for the full 30 seconds, as the first tick counts at t=0.
diagnosis.change_summary: Set period to 100ms to comply with top-level wait duration rules and increased threshold to 301 to account for the first tick at t=0, ensuring the action fires exactly at 30 seconds.
